meta.title: The Developer | SivanInvest Group & Sivan Management, Chania Crete
meta.description: King Solomon is developed by SivanInvest Group, a boutique real estate investment house with nearly 20 years of experience, and managed on site in Chania by Sivan Management.

hero.title: We do not start with the market. We start with you.
hero.subtitle: King Solomon is developed by SivanInvest Group and managed on site by Sivan Management.

about.title: A boutique investment house, rooted in Greece.
about.text: SivanInvest is a boutique investment house that selects, develops, manages and accompanies real estate investments in Israel and, above all, in Greece. With almost two decades of experience in finance and nearly ten years on the ground in the Greek market, we have guided hundreds of investors along a personal, carefully planned path.
about.text2: Every opportunity passes the same discipline: market research, in-depth due diligence, a close look at partners and contractors, cash-flow models and stress scenarios. Capital preservation comes before return maximisation. Always.

values.title: Personal guidance
values.text: One dedicated account manager coordinating the financial, legal and operational sides of your purchase.

values.title: Full transparency
values.text: You see what we examine, which metrics we use, what everything costs and what protects your capital.

values.title: A multidisciplinary team
values.text: Real estate, development, private credit and funds, together with lawyers, accountants, valuers and asset managers.

values.title: On the ground in Crete
values.text: An office in the heart of Chania and a local operations team available 24/7.

group.title: Developer, operator and investment house under one roof.

items.title: SivanInvest
items.text: Develops King Solomon and leads land acquisition, planning, construction partners and investor relations.

items.title: Sivan Management
items.text: Operates the resort: shared facilities, villa care, housekeeping, rentals and yield management.

items.title: HARMONY
items.text: The group's real-estate-backed bond fund, for investors who prefer a fixed-income route into Greek property.

hero.title: Your own villa, pool and sea view in Crete.
hero.text: Fully furnished, professionally managed and ready to rent from the day you receive the keys. On a first-line cliff in Kalyves, 12 minutes from Chania.

why.title: A villa in Crete, on another level.
why.text: A boutique collection of 21 villas where design is part of the value. Contemporary Mediterranean architecture by 314 Architects, a private pool for every villa and a resort-level infinity pool, spa and glass elevator, all on the cliff above Souda Bay.

items.title: First line to the sea
items.text: 34 m above the water, 70 m from the shore, around 270° of uninterrupted sea view.

items.title: Turnkey and furnished

items.title: Income while you are away
